title: 39座数据中心：逼停芝加哥，谁为数据中心买单？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson is pushing for a temporary moratorium on data centers and signed an executive order on Tuesday to create new rules for any future developments.
segments.zh: 芝加哥市长布兰登·约翰逊正推动数据中心建设暂停令，并于周二签署行政命令，为未来开发制定新规。

segments.en: For more on this, Bloomberg's Miranda Davis joins us now live from Chicago.
segments.zh: 更多详情，彭博社的米兰达·戴维斯在芝加哥连线报道。

segments.en: So Miranda just, I mean, honestly, when I think of Chicago, I don't really think of a place that has a ton of data centers, but talk to us about why this is something that we saw
segments.zh: 米兰达，说实话，提到芝加哥，我并不会想到那里有很多数据中心，但请告诉我们为什么会出现这种情况。

segments.en: happen. Yeah, I think it's really easy to kind of think this is an a huge problem for cities.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为人们很容易认为这对城市来说是个大问题。

segments.en: This is a more suburban or rural issue where we're seeing a lot of pushback.
segments.zh: 这更多是郊区或农村的问题，我们看到很多反对声音。

segments.en: But Chicago's geographically a pretty large place, and this area has 39 data centers according to the mayor's office.
segments.zh: 但芝加哥地理面积相当大，据市长办公室称，该地区有39个数据中心。

segments.en: So this is something that they want to tackle and kind of make sense if you think about the broader Chicago area.
segments.zh: 所以他们想解决这个问题，考虑到整个芝加哥地区，这很合理。

segments.en: And how is it emblematic of just a broader trend?
segments.zh: 这如何体现一个更广泛的趋势？

segments.en: Because we haven't only seen pushback in Chicago. This is somewhat becoming more of a country-wide issue.
segments.zh: 因为我们不仅在芝加哥看到反对，这正逐渐成为全国性问题。

segments.en: Of course, we saw the news a little bit earlier with Governor Hookle in New York.
segments.zh: 当然，我们早些时候看到纽约州州长霍克尔的新闻。

segments.en: What are you kind of seeing at least happen in the Midwest? Yeah, I mean, Governor Hookle's effort in New York, I think, has been the most successful
segments.zh: 在中西部，您看到了什么？是的，我认为胡克尔州长在纽约的努力是最成功的，

segments.en: so far in that it's a full moratorium on all hyperscaler data centers.
segments.zh: 因为那是对所有超大规模数据中心全面暂停。

segments.en: But this is not new to the Midwest.
segments.zh: 但这在中西部并不新鲜。
